items.summary: Recommendation: queue three reversible SEO improvements on xxxtea.com, marineactivity.com, and fishhooklabs.com, while preserving Great American Lakes measurement and keeping SearchWoot private. Evidence: the 30-day SEO window shows xxxtea.com with 87 impressions split across five pages; marineactivity.com with 239 impressions, 2 clicks, and position 8.3; fishhooklabs.com with 138 impressions, 2 clicks, and position 9.3. Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21, but site-level revenue, margin, and ROI are not calculable because one tracking ID is unmapped and attribution is incomplete. The main unknown is whether the SEO changes increase qualified clicks or conversions. Smallest next step: queue the three bounded changes and measure at 14 days or 100 new impressions, rolling back if guardrails regress. Owner question: for SearchWoot, choose A) keep private pending all legal, security, accuracy, and measurement gates (recommended), or B) authorize preparation only—not sending—of a written Woot permission request.
